headline: India Auto Production Growth Expected to Slow in 2027 Amid Margin Pressures
summary: Passenger vehicle and two-wheeler production growth in India is expected to moderate in early 2027, while rising raw material and energy costs squeeze supplier margins.
why: Automotive sector trends serve as an essential barometer for consumer discretionary demand, manufacturing employment, and industrial commodity consumption.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Higher energy and raw material costs combined with slowing production growth create headwinds for automotive component supplier margins.
